function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate comprehensively whether and how the Lazarus Group and/or APT38 have been publicly linked to both the Ronin Bridge theft and the Harmony Horizon theft. Use only evidence returned by the benchmark tools and preserve every source ID exactly as provided; do not invent IDs, entity names, wallet relationships, or facts. Prioritize primary and official attribution (government, law enforcement, sanctions notices, company statements) and directly evidenced on-chain material, while including secondary research or analytic reports only when returned. Organize the evidence around: (1) public attribution by governments, law-enforcement agencies, companies, researchers, or other identified sources, identifying the actor, date, wording, and certainty; (2) similarities and differences in laundering methods, transaction flows, intermediary services, asset conversion, sanctions exposure, and timing; and (3) wallet addresses, on-chain relationships, fund movements, and other wallet evidence associated with alleged actors. Explicitly separate verified facts, allegations, analytical assessments, and uncertainty; identify contradictions, gaps, alternative explanations, and any limits caused by missing sources. Do not assume a publication-date range, jurisdiction, source hierarchy, attribution threshold, or certainty standard—report those as open parameters. Return a detailed evidence dossier suitable for a final readable Markdown report and a fenced JSON object with exactly the arrays findings, claims, reasoning_steps, and contradictions. Each finding must have question, answer, supporting_entities, source_references; each claim must have claim, source_references; each reasoning step must have id, conclusion, premise_entities, premise_relations; each contradiction must have contradiction_id, description, source_references. Ensure all source references are only IDs actually returned by the benchmark tools."}
function.name: ConductResearch
